Any evaluation needs an isolated unit, known-good recovery access, preserved logs/image, baseline-versus-change A/B, repeatable workload/soak, and rollback that restores the original boot target and initramfs. Do not infer that the memory technique causes the reported downclock; reports say it occurred with modeset both on and off.
